body:
This reminds me, we should probably rename our customized copy of Inter to something else for [licensing reasons](https://openfontlicense.org/ofl-reserved-font-names/):

> "Inter" is a Reserved Font Name by Rasmus Andersson ([font vendor code RSMS.](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/typography/vendors/#r))
>
> *Source: https://github.com/rsms/inter*

This should apply to the CSS `font-family` value as well.

If we decide to go forward with this, we should do this in a separate PR and make this PR depend on that other PR.

Sounds good, can you open a proposal?

While we're at it, this may be a good idea to use `index.html` as the name of the main file by default, at least for the web editor. This way, most web servers will pick it up automatically with no path to the `.html` file required (pretty URLs).
